note: Rolling prairie, timber and old fields with fishing ponds north of Carrollton, crossed by gravel county roads (CR 120, 122, 130, 171, 177, 191, 195). Camping is at 13 numbered primitive spots, each beside one of the area's gravel parking lots, spread across about 6 km; the lane to the westernmost lot, off Route F, is marked impassable in wet conditions. No facilities; spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Individual Campsites' - 13 mapped Primitive Camping Areas, one per parking lot, ~6 km end to end; free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit. Pin on spot 222 beside its gravel lot - fine. No split (single lot-side spots). Not waterfront kept; one pond lead at spot 220. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: the area page lists 'Camping: Individual Campsites'. The brochure (12/2025) says 'Camping is permitted only in designated areas and is limited to 14 consecutive days in a 30-day period'. The 07/17 map shows 13 numbered parking lots, each with a Primitive Camping Area symbol, on CR 171, 177, 181, 130, 191, 122, 195, 120 and Route Z. GIS layer 27 has 13 points (210-222) and layer 26 has 13 matching lots. All lots say 'Paved' and 'Allows_Trailers: No', which looks like a layer default: the two lots viewed are white gravel. The map marks the road to lot 1 from Route F as 'Impassable during wet conditions' and the next lane south as 'Impassable to vehicles'. Every other lot sits on a gravel county road. No ford seen and no posted limit.

CLUSTER: 13 single lot-side spots spread from 39.56856,-93.61591 (SW, lot 5 area) to 39.59894,-93.56115 (NE, lot 13), ~6 km end to end. No split: none is a distinct camping area, and each is one spot at one lot.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront, kept) - lead at one spot: GIS camping point 220 (39.58857,-93.55729, map lot 12 on CR 120/Route Z) is a mown field ~60 m from Pond #10 across brush. Its gravel turnaround lot (121) is ~30 m from the pond through trees. Pond #10's size wasn't measured, and the spot is 2.5 km from the pin. Lead only.
PIN: stored 39.59480,-93.58544 = GIS camping point 222. It's in a mown grass strip ~20 m south of gravel lot 1387, which opens off the area's north gravel road (map lot 10, CR 195 area) - fine.
PHONE: (660) 646-6122 on the area page matches.
Note rewritten: generic MDC text, acreage, the 14-day line and the directions dropped; spot layout and the wet-weather road described.
